messages.subject: Should I adjust P-values from growth models?

Hello,

I am running multiple parallel (bivariate) growth models (n=30) , when I get my p-values should I do adjustments for them? Or are the p values from latent growth models already adjusted?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Should I adjust P-values from growth models?
parts: when I get my p-values should I do adjustments for them? Or are the p values from latent growth models already adjusted?

Adjusted for what?  If you are talking about multiple testing, you can use the p.adjust() function that comes with base R (in the stats package)
